delivery.feedback: State severity in the first line, such as 'grey, sweating, chest tight, speaking few words', and add air-quality or hazard info on the floor.

feedback: Severity is missing. Your message never says the patient is grey, sweating, has a tight chest and speaks only a few words at a time. Put that in the first line so the crew treats it as critical.

Three details aren't in the building data: 'CBRE', the phone number 5556193343, and 'daytime' occupancy. Remove them. A crew can't rely on a number that may be wrong. Write 'property manager contact: not on file'.

Nothing covers the air-quality cause or the suite, which were the needs listed first. Say that no air-quality information is on file for the floor, and give the CME Group suite if you have it. Say whether the patient should wait where he is or be met downstairs.
